summary: group_by creates in-memory groups from facts for later plays, converts spaces to dashes, and reports changed for tracking even though it doesn't touch the host.
questions: How do I group hosts dynamically by OS or architecture?
What happens to spaces in group_by group names?

answer_card.title: Create dynamic groups with group_by
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.group_by` creates ad-hoc inventory groups from facts for later plays (e.g. `hosts: machine_x86_64`). Spaces become `-`. It reports `changed` for tracking, though the host isn't modified. Works on Windows.
